notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
changes:
• "target shot" works completly different now when used on a ray gun
• "multi shot" gives multiple rays on level 1
• "split shot" splits ray on level 1
• nerfed puzzlebeast (20% less life)

minor fixes:
• fixed a bug that causes game to crash
• mouse should not appear above game
• destroyed quest targets are not highlighted on the minimap anymore
• version number is now displayed at the buttom at the menu screen
• stars in menu are not moving anymore when you move the mouse
• added tips/fixed typos
• on high resolutions (when zoomed out) objects doesn't "pop up" out of nowhere when loaded
